units.source_text: 如此闲玩嬉笑，岁月空过。

en.t: In this way, they idled and laughed in play, while the years passed by in vain.

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍关念两位女公子前途，费却不少心思。

en.t: Lady Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, worried about the futures of the two young ladies and gave the matter much thought.
Emperor Reizei sent letters every day.

units.source_text: 弘徽殿女御也来信说：“你不答应，敢是疏远我么？

en.t: The Kokiden Consort also wrote, saying, “Since you will not agree, can it be that you mean to distance yourself from me?

units.source_text: 上皇埋怨我，说我嫉妒，从中阻挠。

en.t: The Retired Emperor complains of me, saying that I am jealous and am standing in the way.
Though he says it in jest, it is unpleasant all the same.

units.source_text: 如蒙允可，务请早日决定。”

en.t: If you are willing to give your consent, please be sure to decide soon.”

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍想道：“看来是命中注定的了。

en.t: Lady Tamakazura thought, “It seems this must have been destined.

units.source_text: 如此专心诚意，实在不胜感激！”

en.t: With such single-minded sincerity, I truly cannot help feeling grateful!”

units.source_text: 便决定送大女公子入冷泉院。

en.t: She therefore decided to send her elder daughter to Emperor Reizei.

units.source_text: 妆奁服饰等物，久已置备齐全。

en.t: Her cosmetics, clothing, and other such things had long since been fully prepared.

units.source_text: 侍女用服装以及其他零星物品，立刻赶紧筹办。

en.t: The attendants’ clothing and the other small articles were immediately arranged in haste.
